Custom String("LOKASI SERVER: {0}", Global.NamaLokasiIndonesia[Global.IndeksLokasiServer]) : Custom String("ตำแหน่งเซิร์ฟเวอร์: {0}", Global.NamaLokasiThai[Global.IndeksLokasiServer]),

			Left, -2, Color(White), Custom Color(185, 225, 255, 255), Custom Color(70, 225, 255, 255),

rule("00a1 - Umum: Mulai mode segera saat menunggu pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.ModeMulaiDiminta == False;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Waiting For Players == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Permintaan mulai hanya boleh dikirim sekali sampai pertandingan berikutnya."
		Global.ModeMulaiDiminta = True;
		Start Game Mode;
	}
}

rule("00a2 - Umum: Lewati pemilihan pahlawan")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati == False;
		Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) == 0;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is Assembling Heroes == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Jalankan satu kali hanya pada fase awal; pindah tim saat pertandingan berjalan tidak boleh memanggil Set Match Time berulang kali."
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati = True;
		Set Match Time(0);
	}
}

rule("00a3 - Umum: Lewati persiapan awal")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.PersiapanDilewati == False;
		Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) == 0;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null;
		Is Game In Progress == False;
		Is In Setup == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Lewati persiapan sekali saja agar aturan global tidak menembak Set Match Time terus-menerus."
		Global.PersiapanDilewati = True;
		Set Match Time(0);
	}
}

rule("00a4 - Umum: Kunci skip fase awal setelah mode berjalan")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Game In Progress == True;
		Or(Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati == False, Global.PersiapanDilewati == False);
	}

	actions
	{
		"Setelah mode berjalan, skip fase awal dikunci agar pindah tim tidak menembak Set Match Time(0)."
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati = True;
		Global.PersiapanDilewati = True;
	}
}

rule("00c - Umum: Mulai ulang tepat sekali saat hitung mundur habis")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Global.MulaiUlangSudahDiminta == False;
		Global.SisaWaktuServer <= 0;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Kunci mencegah beberapa aksi mulai ulang pada langkah yang sama; tidak ada pemenang atau skor yang diumumkan."
		Global.MulaiUlangSudahDiminta = True;
		Global.PilihPahlawanDilewati = False;
		Global.PersiapanDilewati = False;
		Global.ModeMulaiDiminta = False;
		Restart Match;
	}
}

rule("01a - Siklus tim: Reset penuh pada konteks pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir != Team Of(Event Player);
	}

	actions
	{
		"Reset atomik memakai Event Player yang benar; slot dan HUD lama dilepas sebelum antrean penyiapan baru."
		Call Subroutine(TenangkanPemain);
		Call Subroutine(BersihkanPemain);
		Event Player.SegarkanRosterTertunda = False;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses = False;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif = False;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.TimSiklusTarget = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
			Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
			Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
	}
}

rule("01b - Siklus tim: Pekerja penyiapan dari penjadwal global")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses == True;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player;
		Event Player.TimSiklusTarget == Team Of(Event Player);
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif == False;
		Event Player.SudahSiap == False;
		Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(TenangkanPemain);
		Call Subroutine(SiapkanPemain);
	}
}

rule("02 - Pemain: Pisahkan manusia dari pasukan kaleng")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.SudahSiap == True;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif == False;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
		Event Player.Manusia = False;
		Event Player.WarnaNama = Color(White);
		If(And(Event Player.PernahDisiapkan == True, And(Event Player.NamaTampilan != Null, Event Player.NamaTampilan != Custom String(""))));
			"Gunakan nama cache saat pindah tim agar pemain manusia terdaftar tidak terjebak probe iBot."
			Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
		Else;
			Start Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player, Custom String("​"));
			Wait(0.016, Ignore Condition);
			Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
			If(Or(Event Player.SudahSiap == False, Has Spawned(Event Player) == False));
				Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player);
				Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Custom String("{0}", Event Player) == Custom String("​"));
				Event Player.BotOtomatis = True;
			Else;
				Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
			End;
			Stop Forcing Dummy Bot Name(Event Player);
		End;
		If(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True);
			Cancel Primary Action(Event Player);
			Call Subroutine(KunciBot);
			Abort;
		End;

		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == False);
		Abort If(Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player));
		If(Count Of(Global.SlotHUDTersedia) == 0);
			Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
			Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
			Event Player.PindahTimDiproses = False;
			Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif = False;
			Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
				Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
				Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Abort;
		End;
		"Bekukan nama manusia sekali saat identitasnya valid. HUD roster dan teks dunia memakai salinan ini agar token player tidak kosong setelah pindah tim."
		Event Player.NamaTampilan = Evaluate Once(Custom String("{0}", Event Player));
		If(Or(Event Player.NamaTampilan == Null, Event Player.NamaTampilan == Custom String("")));
			"Nama manusia yang masih kosong belum merupakan identitas stabil: jangan pakai slot roster dan jadwalkan ulang setup ringan."
			Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
			Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
			Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
				Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
				Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
			End;
			Abort;
		End;
		"Sembunyikan bilah, objektif, dan ikon mode tanpa mengganggu HUD pahlawan serta HUD buatan kita."
		Disable Game Mode HUD(Event Player);
		Disable Game Mode In-World UI(Event Player);
		Event Player.IndeksGenre = -1;
		Event Player.IndeksWarna = 0;
		Event Player.WarnaNama = Global.DaftarWarna[Event Player.IndeksWarna];
		If(Custom String("{0}", Event Player) == Custom String("งูแท้"));
			Event Player.MusikKhusus = Custom String("Caladan Brood");
			Event Player.IndeksWarna = 1;
			Event Player.KursorWarna = 1;
			Event Player.WarnaNama = Global.DaftarWarna[1];
			Event Player.WarnaMenu = Global.DaftarWarnaRGB[1];
			Event Player.IndeksIkon = 23;
			Event Player.KursorIkon = 23;
		End;
		Event Player.MenitLobi = 0;
		Event Player.UrutanHUD = First Of(Global.SlotHUDTersedia);
		Global.SlotHUDTerakhir = Max(Global.SlotHUDTerakhir, Event Player.UrutanHUD);
		Modify Global Variable(SlotHUDTersedia, Remove From Array By Index, 0);
		Global.PemainManusia = Append To Array(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player);
		Disable Nameplates(Event Player, Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Player Variable(Current Array Element, InspeksiAktif) == True));

		Global.HudKiriPemain = Append To Array(Global.HudKiriPemain, 0);
		Global.HudKananPemain = Append To Array(Global.HudKananPemain, 0);
		Global.HudMenuPemain = Append To Array(Global.HudMenuPemain, 0);
		Global.TeksDuniaPemain = Append To Array(Global.TeksDuniaPemain, 0);
		Global.SlotHUDPemain = Append To Array(Global.SlotHUDPemain, Event Player.UrutanHUD);
		Event Player.Manusia = True;
		Event Player.PahlawanTerakhir = Hero Of(Event Player);
		Call Subroutine(HitungPilihan);
	}
}

rule("02b - HUD Pemain: Buat segera setelah klasifikasi selesai")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir == Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.SegarkanRosterTertunda == False;
		Event Player.NamaTampilan != Null;
		Event Player.NamaTampilan != Custom String("");
		Event Player.HudPemainDibuat == False;
		Event Player.HudKiri == Null;
		Event Player.HudKanan == Null;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Klasifikasi manusia dan bot sudah selesai. HUD pemain dibuat sekali pada keadaan muncul yang stabil."
		Create HUD Text(Global.PemainManusia, Null, Custom String("{0}{1}{2}", Custom String("{0} {1} {2}",
			Global.DaftarIkon[Event Player.IndeksIkon], Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Event Player) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player) : Hero Of(Event Player)),
			Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 0 ? Custom String("{0} - {1} MIN", Event Player.NamaTampilan, Event Player.MenitLobi) : Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("{0} - {1} MENIT", Event Player.NamaTampilan, Event Player.MenitLobi) : Custom String("{0} - {1} นาที", Event Player.NamaTampilan, Event Player.MenitLobi)), Event Player.UrutanHUD == Global.SlotHUDTerakhir ? Global.PemimpinPilihan != Null
			? Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 2 ? Custom String("\n \nดาวสายชิล: {0}", Global.PemimpinPilihan)
			: Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("\n \nBINTANG CHILL: {0}", Global.PemimpinPilihan)
			: Custom String("\n \nCHILL STAR: {0}", Global.PemimpinPilihan) : Custom String("") : Custom String(""),
			And(Global.DiagnostikPerforma == True, And(Local Player == Host Player, Event Player.UrutanHUD == Global.SlotHUDTerakhir)) ? Custom String("{0}\n{1}",
			Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 2 ? Custom String("\n \nโหลด {0}% | เฉลี่ย {1}% | สูงสุด {2}%", Server Load,
			Server Load Average, Server Load Peak) : Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String(
			"\n \nBEBAN {0}% | RATA {1}% | PUNCAK {2}%", Server Load, Server Load Average, Server Load Peak) : Custom String(
			"\n \nLOAD {0}% | AVG {1}% | MAX {2}%", Server Load, Server Load Average, Server Load Peak), Custom String("HUD {0} | IWT {1}",
			10 + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HudKiriPemain, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HudKananPemain,
			Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.HudMenuPemain, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(
			Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, HudEfekNasib) != Null, Player Variable(
			Current Array Element, HudEfekNasib) != 0))), Count Of(Filtered Array(Global.TeksDuniaPemain, Current Array Element != 0)) + Count Of(
			Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, TeksTeleportasi) != Null, Player Variable(
			Current Array Element, TeksTeleportasi) != 0))) + Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Player Variable(
			Current Array Element, TeksVisiNasib) != Null, Player Variable(Current Array Element, TeksVisiNasib) != 0))))) : Custom String("")), Null, Left,
			1 + Event Player.UrutanHUD, Color(White), Event Player.WarnaNama, Color(White),
			Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.HudKiri = Last Text ID;
		If(And(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0, Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.HudKiriPemain)));
			Global.HudKiriPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = Event Player.HudKiri;
		End;
		Create HUD Text(Global.PemainManusia, Null, Custom String("{0} {1} {2}", Global.DaftarIkon[Event Player.IndeksIkon],
			Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Event Player) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player) : Hero Of(Event Player)), Custom String("{0} - {1}", Event Player.NamaTampilan,
			Event Player.MusikKhusus != Null ? Event Player.MusikKhusus : Event Player.IndeksGenre >= 0 ? Global.DaftarGenre[Event Player.IndeksGenre] : Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 0 ? Custom String("no soundtrack yet")
			: Player Variable(Local Player, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("belum pilih musik") : Custom String("ยังไม่ได้เลือกเพลง"))), Null, Right, -13 + Event Player.UrutanHUD,
			Color(White), Event Player.WarnaNama, Color(White), Visible To String and Color, Visible Never);
		Event Player.HudKanan = Last Text ID;
		If(And(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0, Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.HudKananPemain)));
			Global.HudKananPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = Event Player.HudKanan;
		End;
		Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = True;
		Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String(
			"Welcome to CHILL. Pick a vibe, pick a color, stay weird.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String(
			"Selamat datang di CHILL. Pilih vibe, pilih warna, tetap aneh.") : Custom String(
			"ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ CHILL เลือกเพลง เลือกสี แล้วกวนแบบพอดี ๆ"));
	}
}

rule("03c - Bot/Dummy: Kunci saat hidup kembali atau pahlawan berganti")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Or(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player), Event Player.BotOtomatis) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Or(Event Player.KunciBotAktif == False, Hero Of(Event Player) != Event Player.PahlawanTerakhir) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(KunciBot);
		If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True);
			Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
			Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player, False);
			Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			Set Respawn Max Time(Event Player, 3);
		End;
	}
}

rule("03d - Bot/Dummy: Buat satu bot acak untuk Tim 1")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Game In Progress == True;
		Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null;
		Number Of Players(Team 1) < Number Of Slots(Team 1) - 1;
		Count Of(Spawn Points(Team 1)) > 0;
		Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Team 1), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0;
	}

	actions
	{
		Global.TimDummyAktif = Team 1;
		Call Subroutine(BuatDummyTim);
	}
}

rule("03f - Bot/Dummy: Teleport dari ruang spawn ke objektif")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True;
		Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))) > 0;
		Or(Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy == 0, Total Time Elapsed >= Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy == 0);
			Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
			Abort;
		End;
		Event Player.PosisiMati = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		If(Or(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Escort), Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Hybrid)));
			If(Distance Between(Payload Position, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiMati = Payload Position;
			End;
		Else If(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Capture The Flag));
			If(Distance Between(Flag Position(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player))), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiMati = Flag Position(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player)));
			End;
		Else If(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Push));
			If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True, And(Is Alive(Current Array Element) == True, Is On Objective(Current Array Element) == True)))) > 0);
				Event Player.PosisiMati = Position Of(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True, And(Is Alive(Current Array Element) == True, Is On Objective(Current Array Element) == True)))));
			Else If(Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiMati = Objective Position(Objective Index);
			End;
		Else If(Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiMati = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiMati, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiMati + Direction Towards(Event Player.PosisiMati, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))))) * 10);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman;
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
			If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiMati) >= 6);
				If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiMati) <= 16);
					If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 5, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman - Vector(0, 20, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman) <= 6);
						If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
							Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman);
						End;
					End;
				End;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy = Total Time Elapsed + 1;
	}
}

rule("03g - Bot/Dummy: Hadap dan dekati manusia musuh hidup terdekat")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti != Null;
		Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == True;
		Player Variable(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti, Manusia) == True;
		Player Variable(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti, IzinkanDummyMengikuti) == True;
		Has Spawned(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == True;
		Team Of(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player));
	}

	actions
	{
		Start Facing(Event Player, Direction Towards(Eye Position(Event Player), Eye Position(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti)), 1000, To World, Direction and Turn Rate);
		Start Throttle In Direction(Event Player, Forward, Or(Is In Spawn Room(Event Player), Distance Between(Event Player, Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) <= 4) ? 0 : 1, To Player, Replace Existing Throttle, Direction and Magnitude);
	}
}

rule("03h - Bot/Dummy: Hentikan gerak saat tidak ada manusia musuh hidup")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Or(Or(Or(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti == Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == False), Or(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti, Manusia) == False, Player Variable(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti, IzinkanDummyMengikuti) == False)), Or(Or(Has Spawned(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) == False), Team Of(Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti) != Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player)))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Stop Facing(Event Player);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Event Player);
	}
}

rule("03i - Bot/Dummy: Hentikan gerak saat bot mati")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Stop Facing(Event Player);
		Stop Throttle In Direction(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy = 0;
		Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti = Null;
	}
}

rule("04 - Pemain Keluar: Bersihkan hanya saat benar-benar keluar")
{
	event
	{
		Player Left Match;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Or(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True, Or(Event Player.Manusia == True, Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.BotOtomatis == True);
			If(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
				Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
			End;
			Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
			Abort;
		End;
		Wait(0.500, Ignore Condition);
		Abort If(Entity Exists(Event Player) == True);
		Call Subroutine(BersihkanPemain);
		If(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Event Player);
			Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
			Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
	}
}

rule("04g - Utama global: Penjadwal pusat 20 Hz")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Global;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Global.Siap == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Langkah 0,05 detik adalah satu-satunya sumber tick dan satu-satunya Loop di seluruh skrip."
		Global.LangkahPenjadwal = (Global.LangkahPenjadwal + 1) % 200;
		If(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 2 == 0);
			Global.RGB = Custom Color(
				80 + (Global.RGBFase < 255 ? 255 : Global.RGBFase < 510 ? 510 - Global.RGBFase : Global.RGBFase < 1020 ? 0 : Global.RGBFase < 1275 ? Global.RGBFase - 1020 : 255) * 0.686,
				80 + (Global.RGBFase < 255 ? Global.RGBFase : Global.RGBFase < 765 ? 255 : Global.RGBFase < 1020 ? 1020 - Global.RGBFase : 0) * 0.686,
				80 + (Global.RGBFase < 510 ? 0 : Global.RGBFase < 765 ? Global.RGBFase - 510 : Global.RGBFase < 1275 ? 255 : 1530 - Global.RGBFase) * 0.686,
				255);
			Global.RGBFase = (Global.RGBFase + 3) % 1530;
		End;
		If(And(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 20 == 0, Global.MulaiUlangSudahDiminta == False));
			Global.SisaWaktuServer = Max(0, Round To Integer(Global.WaktuAkhirServer - Total Time Elapsed, Up));
			Global.TeksWaktuServer = Global.SisaWaktuServer % 60 < 10 ? Custom String("{0}:0{1}", Round To Integer(Global.SisaWaktuServer / 60, Down),
				Global.SisaWaktuServer % 60) : Custom String("{0}:{1}", Round To Integer(Global.SisaWaktuServer / 60, Down), Global.SisaWaktuServer % 60);
			If(And(Is Game In Progress == True, Global.SisaWaktuServer > 0));
				"Satu kali per detik, tahan penyelesaian mode bawaan dan sinkronkan timer native di atas nol sampai timer server selesai."
				Disable Built-In Game Mode Completion;
				Set Match Time(Max(1, Global.SisaWaktuServer + 5));
			End;
		End;
		If(And(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal != Null, Or(Entity Exists(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal) == False, Has Spawned(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal) == False)));
			Global.PemainSiklusGlobal = Null;
			Global.WaktuSiklusGlobal = Total Time Elapsed + 0.250;
		End;
		"Indeks dan pemain aktif hanya dimiliki penjadwal; tidak ada jeda selama pemindaian."
		For Global Variable(IndeksPemainGlobal, 0, Count Of(All Players(All Teams)), 1);
			Global.PemainAktif = All Players(All Teams)[Global.IndeksPemainGlobal];
			If(Or(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null, Global.PemainAktif == Global.PemainSiklusGlobal));
				Call Subroutine(ProsesCepatPemain);
				Call Subroutine(ProsesNasibPemain);
				Call Subroutine(ProsesTerbangPemain);
			End;
			If(And(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 2 == 0, Or(Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null, Global.PemainAktif == Global.PemainSiklusGlobal)));
				Call Subroutine(ProsesSiklusPemain);
			End;
			If(And(Global.LangkahPenjadwal % 20 == 0, Global.PemainSiklusGlobal == Null));
				Call Subroutine(ProsesCachePemain);
			End;
			If(And(Global.LangkahPenjadwal == 0, And(Global.PemainAktif.Manusia == True, Entity Exists(Global.PemainAktif))));
				Set Player Variable(Global.PemainAktif, MenitLobi, Max(0, Round To Integer((Total Time Elapsed - Global.PemainAktif.WaktuMasuk) / 60, Down)));
			End;
		End;
		Global.PemainAktif = Null;
		Wait(0.050, Ignore Condition);
		Loop If Condition Is True;
	}
}

rule("05 - Menu: Tahan serangan jarak dekat 0,5 detik untuk buka atau tutup")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai == False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif == False;
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Wait(0.500, Abort When False);
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = True;
		If(Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True);
			Call Subroutine(TutupMenu);
		Else;
			Event Player.MenuTerbuka = True;
			Event Player.HalamanMenu = -1;
			Call Subroutine(GambarMenu);
			Call Subroutine(TransisiWarnaMenu);
		End;
	}
}

rule("05b - Menu: Lepaskan serangan jarak dekat sebelum pakai lagi")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Melee)) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False);
			Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
		End;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = False;
	}
}

rule("05c - Menu: Pengatur masukan dengan prioritas tetap")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu == 0;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai == False;
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == False;
		Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)), And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)), Event Player.HalamanMenu != -1)), Or(Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire))), And(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2, Or(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)), Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)))))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)));
			Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = True;
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 1;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)), Event Player.HalamanMenu != -1));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 2;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 3;
		Else If(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 4;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)), Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 5;
		Else If(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)), Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2));
			Event Player.PerintahMenu = 6;
		End;
	}
}

rule("05d - Menu: Lepaskan pengatur setelah semua masukan dilepas")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu != 0;
		And(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Reload)) == False), And(And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire)) == False), And(Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 1)) == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Ability 2)) == False))) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Aktifkan kembali pengatur segera setelah semua tombol dilepas; pengunci tetap mencegah pengulangan saat tombol ditahan."
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
	}
}

rule("05e - Menu: Crouch mengunci masukan pahlawan hanya saat navigasi")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci = True;
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("05f - Menu: Lepaskan Crouch dan segera pulihkan masukan pahlawan")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci == True;
		Or(Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False, Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
	}
}

rule("06 - Menu: Navigasi berikutnya dan sebelumnya")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Or(Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3, Event Player.PerintahMenu == 4) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == -1);
			Event Player.KursorUtama = (Event Player.KursorUtama + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 13)) % 14;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 0);
			Event Player.KursorWarna = (Event Player.KursorWarna + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.DaftarWarna) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.DaftarWarna);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 1);
			Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetKamera);
			Event Player.KursorKamera = (Event Player.KursorKamera + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 1)) % (Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 2);
		Else If(And(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2, Event Player.MusikKhusus == Null));
			Event Player.KursorGenre = (Event Player.KursorGenre + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 99)) % 100;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 3);
			Event Player.KursorBahasa = (Event Player.KursorBahasa + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 4);
			Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetBalasDendam);
			If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) > 0);
				Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = (Event Player.KursorBalasDendam + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) - 1)) % Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 5);
			Event Player.KursorKebal = (Event Player.KursorKebal + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 6);
			Event Player.KursorSuara = (Event Player.KursorSuara + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : 4)) % 5;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 7);
			Event Player.KursorIkon = (Event Player.KursorIkon + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.DaftarIkon) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.DaftarIkon);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 8);
			Event Player.KursorTeleportasiJongkok = (Event Player.KursorTeleportasiJongkok + 1) % 2;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 9);
			Event Player.KursorPrivasiInspeksi = (Event Player.KursorPrivasiInspeksi + 1) % 2;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 11);
			If(Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) > 0);
				Event Player.KursorPilihan = (Event Player.KursorPilihan + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 3 ? 1 : Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) - 1)) % Count Of(Global.PemainManusia);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 12);
			Event Player.KursorIkutiDummy = (Event Player.KursorIkutiDummy + 1) % 2;
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 13);
			Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang = (Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang + 1) % 2;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(TransisiWarnaMenu);
	}
}

rule("08 - Menu musik: Lompat maju atau mundur sepuluh genre")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2;
		Event Player.MusikKhusus == Null;
		Or(Event Player.PerintahMenu == 5, Event Player.PerintahMenu == 6) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.KursorGenre = (Event Player.KursorGenre + (Event Player.PerintahMenu == 5 ? 10 : 90)) % 100;
	}
}

rule("10 - Menu: Terapkan halaman aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu == 1;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == -1);
			Event Player.HalamanMenu = Event Player.KursorUtama;
			If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 1);
				Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetKamera);
			Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 4);
				Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetBalasDendam);
			Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 5);
				Event Player.KursorKebal = Event Player.ModeKebal;
			Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 11);
				Event Player.KursorPilihan = And(Event Player.PemainDipilih != Null, Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih)) ? Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih) : Min(Event Player.KursorPilihan, Max(0, Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) - 1));
			Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 12);
				Event Player.KursorIkutiDummy = Event Player.IzinkanDummyMengikuti ? 1 : 0;
			Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 13);
				Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang %= 2;
			End;
			Call Subroutine(GambarMenu);
			Call Subroutine(TransisiWarnaMenu);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 0);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanWarna);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 1);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanKamera);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 2);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanMusik);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 3);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanBahasa);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 4);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanBalasDendam);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 5);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanKebal);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 6);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanSuara);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 7);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanIkon);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 8);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanTeleportasiJongkok);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 9);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanPrivasiInspeksi);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 10);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanNasib);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 11);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanPilihan);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 12);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanIkutiDummy);
		Else If(Event Player.HalamanMenu == 13);
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanHalamanHantuTerbang);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99a - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman musik")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanMusik;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Event Player.MusikKhusus != Null);
		If(Event Player.IndeksGenre != Event Player.KursorGenre);
			Event Player.IndeksGenre = Event Player.KursorGenre;
			Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99b - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman kamera")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanKamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetKamera);
		Event Player.KursorKamera %= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 2;
		If(Event Player.KursorKamera == 0);
			If(Event Player.ModeKamera != 0);
				Stop Camera(Event Player);
				Event Player.ModeKamera = 0;
				Event Player.TargetKamera = Null;
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			End;
		Else If(Event Player.KursorKamera == 1);
			If(Or(Event Player.ModeKamera != 1, Event Player.TargetKamera != Event Player));
				Event Player.TargetKamera = Event Player;
				Event Player.ModeKamera = 1;
				Call Subroutine(MulaiKamera);
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			End;
		Else;
			If(Event Player.KursorKamera - 2 < Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera));
				Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera[Event Player.KursorKamera - 2];
			Else;
				Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Null;
			End;
			If(And(Event Player.CalonTargetKamera != Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.CalonTargetKamera)));
				If(Or(Event Player.ModeKamera != 2, Event Player.TargetKamera != Event Player.CalonTargetKamera));
					Event Player.TargetKamera = Event Player.CalonTargetKamera;
					Event Player.ModeKamera = 2;
					Call Subroutine(MulaiKamera);
					Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
				End;
			Else;
				Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Camera target unavailable.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Pemainnya menghilang. Sangat sesuai tema CHILL.") : Custom String("ผู้เล่นคนนั้นหายไปแล้ว สมกับเป็นห้อง CHILL จริง ๆ"));
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99c - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman warna")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanWarna;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IndeksWarna != Event Player.KursorWarna);
			Event Player.IndeksWarna = Event Player.KursorWarna;
			Event Player.WarnaNama = Global.DaftarWarna[Event Player.IndeksWarna];
			If(Event Player.IndeksWarna == 0);
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99d - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman bahasa")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanBahasa;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IndeksBahasa != Event Player.KursorBahasa);
			Event Player.IndeksBahasa = Event Player.KursorBahasa;
			Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99e - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman balas dendam")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanBalasDendam;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci != Null, And(Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci), Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, PenagihBalasDendam) == Event Player)));
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge is already in progress.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam masih diproses. Utang berubah hanya setelah mati penuh.") : Custom String("กำลังดำเนินการล้างแค้น หนี้จะเปลี่ยนเมื่อเสียชีวิตอย่างสมบูรณ์เท่านั้น"));
		Else;
			Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
			Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetBalasDendam);
			If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) == 0);
				Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No revenge targets.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tidak ada target balas dendam. Damai menang... sementara.") : Custom String("ไม่มีเป้าหมายล้างแค้น ความสงบชนะแล้ว...ชั่วคราว"));
			Else;
				Event Player.KursorBalasDendam %= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam);
				Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam[Event Player.KursorBalasDendam];
				Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam, Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci);
				If(Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam < 0);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No revenge debt for that player.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Pemain itu tidak punya utang. Damainya mencurigakan sekali.") : Custom String("ผู้เล่นคนนั้นไม่ได้ติดหนี้คุณ สงบเกินจนน่าสงสัย"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam[Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam] <= 0);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No revenge debt remaining.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Utang balas dendam lunas. Kasus ditutup.") : Custom String("ชำระหนี้ล้างแค้นหมดแล้ว ปิดคดี"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) == False));
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge target is already down.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target sudah tumbang. Balas dendam juga punya jam kerja.") : Custom String("เป้าหมายล้มอยู่แล้ว การล้างแค้นก็มีเวลาทำการนะ"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, KematianBalasDendam) == True);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge is already active on that target.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target itu sudah memiliki balas dendam yang sedang diproses.") : Custom String("เป้าหมายนั้นมีการล้างแค้นที่กำลังดำเนินอยู่แล้ว"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else If(Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, KartuNasibAktif) == True);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Target is using Try Your Luck.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target itu sedang memakai Coba Nasib. Tunggu sampai selesai.") : Custom String("เป้าหมายนั้นกำลังใช้เสี่ยงโชค รอให้จบก่อน"));
					Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
				Else;
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, KematianBalasDendam, True);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, PenagihBalasDendam, Event Player);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, WaktuPaksaBerikut, Total Time Elapsed);
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, WaktuPaksaBerakhir, Total Time Elapsed + 5);
					Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge armed on {0}.", Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam diarahkan ke {0}. Menunggu mati penuh.", Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) : Custom String("เริ่มล้างแค้น {0} แล้ว กำลังรอการเสียชีวิตอย่างสมบูรณ์", Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci));
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99f - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman kebal")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanKebal;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.ModeKebal != Event Player.KursorKebal);
			If(And(Event Player.KursorKebal == 1, Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True));
				Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Unkillable: 1 HP (HEALABLE) is unavailable in Spawn Room. FULL HP is still available.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Kebal: 1 HP (BISA SEMBUH) tidak tersedia di ruang muncul. FULL HP tetap tersedia.") : Custom String("ใช้โหมดฆ่าไม่ตาย: 1 HP (รักษาได้) ในห้องเกิดไม่ได้ แต่ FULL HP ยังใช้ได้"));
			Else;
				Event Player.ModeKebal = Event Player.KursorKebal;
				Event Player.KebalAktif = Event Player.ModeKebal != 0;
				If(Event Player.ModeKebal == 0);
					Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
					Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
					Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
					Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
					Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
					If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
						Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
					End;
					If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
						Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
						Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
					End;
				Else;
					Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
					Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
					Set Status(Event Player, Null, Unkillable, 9999);
					If(Event Player.ModeKebal == 1);
						Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
						Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
						Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
						If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
							Set Player Health(Event Player, 1);
						End;
					Else;
						Set Damage Received(Event Player, 0);
						Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 0);
						Disable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
						If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
							Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
						End;
					End;
					If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
						Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
						Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
					End;
					If(Event Player.ModeKebal == 1);
						Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Event Player, Warning, Visible To and Position, Custom Color(255, 80, 80, 255), True);
					Else;
						Create Icon(All Players(All Teams), Event Player, Halo, Visible To and Position, Global.RGB, True);
					End;
					Event Player.IkonKebal = Last Created Entity;
				End;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99g - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman suara pahlawan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanSuara;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IndeksSuara != Event Player.KursorSuara);
			Event Player.IndeksSuara = Event Player.KursorSuara;
			If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 0);
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			End;
			If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 0);
				Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player);
			Else If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 1);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 0.500, False);
			Else If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 2);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 0.750, False);
			Else If(Event Player.IndeksSuara == 3);
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 1.250, False);
			Else;
				Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player, 1.500, False);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99h - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman ikon pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanIkon;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IndeksIkon != Event Player.KursorIkon);
			Event Player.IndeksIkon = Event Player.KursorIkon;
			Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
		End;
	}
}

rule("99i - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman teleportasi Jongkok")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanTeleportasiJongkok;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokDiaktifkan != (Event Player.KursorTeleportasiJongkok == 1));
			Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokDiaktifkan = Event Player.KursorTeleportasiJongkok == 1;
			If(Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokDiaktifkan == True);
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99j - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman privasi inspeksi")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanPrivasiInspeksi;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.PrivasiInspeksiAktif != (Event Player.KursorPrivasiInspeksi == 1));
			Event Player.PrivasiInspeksiAktif = Event Player.KursorPrivasiInspeksi == 1;
			If(Event Player.PrivasiInspeksiAktif == True);
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99k - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman coba nasib")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanNasib;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Try Your Luck is already active.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Coba Nasib masih aktif. Tunggu sampai selesai.") : Custom String("เสี่ยงโชคยังทำงานอยู่ รอให้จบก่อน"));
		Else If(Event Player.KematianBalasDendam == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Try Your Luck is unavailable while Revenge resolves.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Kematian balas dendam masih diproses. Coba Nasib sementara tidak tersedia.") : Custom String("กำลังดำเนินการเสียชีวิตจากการล้างแค้น จึงยังใช้เสี่ยงโชคไม่ได้ชั่วคราว"));
		Else;
			Event Player.KartuNasibAktif = True;
			Event Player.EfekNasib = Random Integer(1, 6);
			Event Player.PutaranKartuNasib = Random Integer(20, 24);
			Event Player.JedaKartuNasib = 0.080;
			Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
			Event Player.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
			Event Player.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = Total Time Elapsed;
			Event Player.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
			Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
			Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
			If(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
				Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib);
			End;
			Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
			"Coba Nasib mempertahankan pilihan Kebal; hanya kematian final Skull yang menangguhkan perlindungan sampai Resurrect."
		End;
	}
}

rule("99l - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman pilihan pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanPilihan;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Count Of(Global.PemainManusia) > 0);
			Event Player.KursorPilihan %= Count Of(Global.PemainManusia);
			If(Event Player.PemainDipilih != Global.PemainManusia[Event Player.KursorPilihan]);
				"Setiap pemain memiliki tepat satu pilihan aktif; pilihan lama dikurangi sebelum pilihan baru ditambahkan. Memilih diri sendiri diperbolehkan."
				If(And(Event Player.PemainDipilih != Null, Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih)));
					Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih)], JumlahPilihan, Subtract, 1);
					If(Global.PemainManusia[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih)].JumlahPilihan < 0);
						Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player.PemainDipilih)], JumlahPilihan, 0);
					End;
				End;
				Event Player.PemainDipilih = Global.PemainManusia[Event Player.KursorPilihan];
				Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Event Player.KursorPilihan], JumlahPilihan, Add, 1);
				Call Subroutine(HitungPilihan);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99m - Subrutin: Terapkan izin dummy mengikuti")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanIkutiDummy;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IzinkanDummyMengikuti != (Event Player.KursorIkutiDummy == 1));
			Event Player.IzinkanDummyMengikuti = Event Player.KursorIkutiDummy == 1;
			If(Event Player.IzinkanDummyMengikuti == True);
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			End;
		End;
	}
}

rule("99n - Subrutin: Terapkan halaman Mode Hantu / Terbang")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanHalamanHantuTerbang;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang == 0);
			Event Player.ModeHantuAktif = Event Player.ModeHantuAktif == False;
			If(Event Player.ModeHantuAktif == True);
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			End;
		Else;
			Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif = Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif == False;
			If(Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif == True);
				Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
			Else;
				Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Call Subroutine(TerapkanFisikaHantuTerbang);
	}
}

rule("99o - Subrutin: Terapkan fisika Mode Hantu / Terbang")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TerapkanFisikaHantuTerbang;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.ModeHantuAktif == True);
			Disable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player, False);
		Else;
			Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		If(Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif == True);
			If(Or(Event Player.EfekNasib != 2, Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Event Player, 0);
			End;
			Set Gravity(Event Player, 0);
		Else;
			If(Or(Event Player.EfekNasib != 2, Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir <= Total Time Elapsed));
				Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
				If(Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Event Player)) > 0.010);
					Apply Impulse(Event Player, Velocity Of(Event Player) * -1, Magnitude Of(Velocity Of(Event Player)), To World, Incorporate Contrary Motion);
				End;
			End;
			Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		End;
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = True;
	}
}

rule("11 - Menu: Isi ulang kembali dari submenu ke menu utama")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == True;
		Event Player.HalamanMenu != -1;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu == 2;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.HalamanMenu = -1;
		Call Subroutine(GambarMenu);
		Call Subroutine(TransisiWarnaMenu);
	}
}

rule("12c - Kamera: Tahan Interact setengah detik untuk beralih")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Wait(0.500, Abort When False);
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = True;
		If(Event Player.ModeKamera == 0);
			Event Player.TargetKamera = Event Player;
			Event Player.ModeKamera = 1;
			Call Subroutine(MulaiKamera);
			Call Subroutine(EfekTerapkan);
		Else;
			Stop Camera(Event Player);
			Event Player.ModeKamera = 0;
			Event Player.TargetKamera = Null;
			Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
		End;
	}
}

rule("12d - Kamera: Lepaskan Interact sebelum pakai lagi")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai == True;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Interact)) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = False;
	}
}

rule("12e - Bangkit Lompat: Simpan posisi kematian")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.PosisiMati = Position Of(Event Player);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		Event Player.BangkitLompatDipakai = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Event Player.PerintahTeleportasi = 0;
		Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Press {0}: resurrect here; after a void death, you'll be moved to walkable ground.", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))) : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tekan {0}: bangkit di sini; setelah jatuh ke jurang, kamu akan dipindahkan ke tanah yang bisa dilalui.", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))) : Custom String("กด {0}: ฟื้นตรงนี้; หลังตกเหว ระบบจะย้ายคุณไปยังพื้นที่เดินได้", Input Binding String(Button(Jump))));
	}
}

rule("12f - Bangkit Lompat: Bangkit di posisi aman yang bisa dilalui")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;
		Is Dummy Bot(Event Player) == False;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
		Event Player.BangkitLompatDipakai == False;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Jump)) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.BangkitLompatDipakai = True;
		Resurrect(Event Player);
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiMati + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiMati - Vector(0, 3, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiMati) > 2.500);
			Teleport(Event Player, Nearest Walkable Position(Last Of(Position Of(Event Player))));
		End;
		If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
			Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
			Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
			Call Subroutine(TerapkanFisikaHantuTerbang);
		End;
	}
}

	event

rule("13 - Intip Pahlawan: Nama mengikuti target bidikan tanpa Wait")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False;
		Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif == False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif == False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokDiaktifkan == False;
		Event Player.ModeKamera != 2;
		Is Button Held(Event Player, Button(Crouch)) == True;
		Event Player.TargetInspeksi != Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.InspeksiAktif == False);
			Event Player.InspeksiAktif = True;
			Disable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
			Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan = True;
		End;
		If(Event Player.TeksDunia != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksDunia);
		End;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain));
				Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = 0;
			End;
		End;
		Event Player.TeksDunia = Null;
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetInspeksi);
		Abort If(Event Player.TargetInspeksi == Null);
		Create In-World Text(Event Player, Custom String("{0} {1} | {2}", Hero Icon String(Is Duplicating(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) ? Hero Being Duplicated(Event Player.TargetInspeksi) : Hero Of(Event Player.TargetInspeksi)), Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, Manusia) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, NamaTampilan) : Custom String("{0}", Event Player.TargetInspeksi), Round To Integer(Health(Event Player.TargetInspeksi), Down)), Update Every Frame(Eye Position(Evaluate Once(Event Player.TargetInspeksi)) + Vector(0, 0.450, 0)), 1.100, Do Not Clip, Visible To Position String and Color, Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, Manusia) == True ? Player Variable(Event Player.TargetInspeksi, WarnaNama) : Custom Color(236, 153, 0, 255), Visible Never);
		Event Player.TeksDunia = Last Text ID;
		If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) >= 0);
			If(Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player) < Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain));
				Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Event Player)] = Event Player.TeksDunia;
			End;
		End;
	}
}

{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;

	}

		Event Player.BotOtomatis == False;

	}

	actions

	}
}

rule("17 - Balas Dendam: Catat hanya pembunuh langsung")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KematianBalasDendam == True);
			If(Is Alive(Event Player) == False);
				If(And(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam != Null, And(Entity Exists(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam), And(Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, Manusia) == True, Attacker == Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam))));
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam, Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, PembunuhBalasDendam), Event Player));
					If(And(Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam) >= 0, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)] > 0));
						Modify Player Variable At Index(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam), Subtract, 1);
						Play Effect(All Players(All Teams), Ring Explosion, Global.RGB, Position Of(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam) + Vector(0, 1, 0), 3);
						Small Message(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBahasa) == 0 ? Custom String("Revenge claimed on {0}. Remaining: {1}.", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)]) : Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBahasa) == 1 ? Custom String("Balas dendam dibayar pada {0}. Sisa: {1}.", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)]) : Custom String("ล้างแค้น {0} สำเร็จ เหลือ: {1}", Event Player, Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, JumlahBalasDendam)[Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, IndeksBalasDendam)]));
					End;
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, Null);
					Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
					Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
					Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
					Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
					Abort;
				End;
				If(And(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam != Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam)));
					Set Player Variable(Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam, TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, Null);
				End;
				Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
				Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
				Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
				Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
			Else;
				Abort;
			End;
		End;
		Abort If(Attacker == Null);
		Abort If(Attacker == Event Player);
		Abort If(Player Variable(Attacker, Manusia) == False);
		Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam, Attacker);
		If(Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam < 0);
			Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam = Append To Array(Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam, Attacker);
			Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam = Append To Array(Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam, 1);
		Else;
			Modify Player Variable At Index(Event Player, JumlahBalasDendam, Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam, Add, 1);
		End;
	}
}

rule("18c - Kebal: Nonaktifkan hanya mode 1 HP di Ruang Muncul")
{
	event
	{
		Ongoing - Each Player;
		All;
		All;
	}

	conditions
	{
		Event Player.Manusia == True;
		Event Player.ModeKebal == 1;
		Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.KebalAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeKebal = 0;
		Event Player.KursorKebal = 1;
		Call Subroutine(EfekPulihkan);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		If(Is Alive(Event Player) == True);
			Set Player Health(Event Player, Max Health(Event Player));
		End;
		If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
			Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
		End;
		Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Unkillable: 1 HP (HEALABLE) disabled in Spawn Room.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Kebal: 1 HP (BISA SEMBUH) dimatikan di ruang muncul.") : Custom String("ปิดโหมดฆ่าไม่ตาย: 1 HP (รักษาได้) ในห้องเกิดแล้ว"));
	}
}

rule("18f - Nasib: Bersihkan efek saat mati")
{
	event
	{
		Player Died;
		All;

	}

	conditions
	{
		Or(Event Player.KartuNasibAktif == True, Or(Event Player.PutaranKartuNasib > 0, Event Player.EfekNasib != 0)) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == False;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(PulihkanNasibPemain);
		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = Event Player.MenuTerbuka == False;
	}
}

	{

	}

	conditions
	{

		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka == True;

		Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
		Is Alive(Event Player) == True;

		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
