rule("93b2 - Subrutin: Tenangkan pemicu sebelum pembersihan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TenangkanPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Pulihkan efek mesin sebelum penyiapan menghapus variabel; hanya dipanggil dari konteks Event Player."
		Call Subroutine(TutupMenu);
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Melee));
		Stop Camera(Event Player);
		Stop Modifying Hero Voice Lines(Event Player);
		Stop Chasing Player Variable(Event Player, WarnaMenu);
		If(Event Player.LampiranTeleportasiAktif == True);
			Detach Players(Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.LampiranTeleportasiAktif = False;
		Event Player.TargetLampiranTeleportasi = Null;
		Event Player.PahlawanLampiranSendiri = Null;
		Event Player.PahlawanLampiranTarget = Null;
		If(Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan == True);
			Enable Nameplates(All Players(All Teams), Event Player);
		End;
		Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan = False;
		Event Player.KebalAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeKebal = 0;
		Event Player.KursorKebal = 0;
		Call Subroutine(PulihkanNasibPemain);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
		Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
		"Matikan semua pemicu sebelum acara keluar atau masuk menyelesaikan pembersihan dan pendaftaran baru."
		Event Player.SudahSiap = False;
		Event Player.Manusia = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka = False;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif = False;
		Event Player.PerintahTeleportasi = 0;
		Event Player.InspeksiAktif = False;
		Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Null;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = False;
		Event Player.IzinkanDummyMengikuti = False;
		Event Player.ModeHantuAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif = False;
		Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang = 0;
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Event Player.WaktuBunuhDiriBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		Event Player.PersenTerbang = 100;
		Event Player.ArahTerbang = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.DeltaTerbang = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.HudKiri = Null;
		Event Player.HudKanan = Null;
		Event Player.HudMenu = Null;
		Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = False;
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
	}
}

rule("93c - Subrutin: Bersihkan referensi pemain yang benar-benar keluar")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		BersihkanPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		"Pembersihan keluar hanya menyentuh handle dan roster global; entitas yang sudah hilang tidak dinormalisasi ulang."
		Global.PemainPembersihan = Event Player;
		Global.IndeksKeluar = Index Of Array Value(Global.PemainManusia, Global.PemainPembersihan);
		If(Global.IndeksKeluar > -1);
			If(Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain), Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.HudKiriPemain), Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.HudKananPemain), Or(Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.HudMenuPemain), Global.IndeksKeluar >= Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain))))));
				"Perlindungan mogok: tandai fallback lalu eksekusi pemulihan darurat setelah jalur kanonik."
				Global.IndeksPembersihan = Global.IndeksKeluar;
				Global.IndeksKeluar = -2;
			End;
			If(Global.IndeksKeluar >= 0);
				Global.IndeksPembersihan = Global.IndeksKeluar;
				Global.IndeksUtangKeluar = Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan];
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
					Destroy Icon(Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKartuNasib);
				End;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKebal != Null);
					Destroy Icon(Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKebal);
				End;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib != Null);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib);
				End;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib);
				End;
				If(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi != Null);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi);
				End;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.IkonKebal = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudEfekNasib = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksTeleportasi = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudKiri = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudKanan = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudMenu = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.TeksDunia = Null;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.HudPemainDibuat = False;
				Global.PemainPembersihan.SudahDiperiksa = False;
				"Kurangi pilihan keluar dari target yang masih aktif agar bintang CHILL tidak menyimpan suara hantu."
				If(And(Global.PemainPembersihan.PemainDipilih != Null, And(Global.PemainPembersihan.PemainDipilih != Global.PemainPembersihan, Array Contains(Global.PemainManusia, Global.PemainPembersihan.PemainDipilih))));
					Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainPembersihan.PemainDipilih, JumlahPilihan, Subtract, 1);
					If(Global.PemainPembersihan.PemainDipilih.JumlahPilihan < 0);
						Set Player Variable(Global.PemainPembersihan.PemainDipilih, JumlahPilihan, 0);
					End;
				End;
				"Hapus pilihan yang menunjuk pemain keluar sebelum slot entitas dapat dipakai ulang oleh orang lain."
				Set Player Variable(Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Player Variable(Current Array Element, PemainDipilih) == Global.PemainPembersihan), PemainDipilih, Null);
				"Bersihkan pasangan utang dan klaim balas dendam sebelum referensi slot dapat dipakai ulang."
				For Global Variable(IndeksPemilih, 0, Count Of(Global.PemainManusia), 1);
					If(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih] != Global.PemainPembersihan);
						Global.IndeksDendamKeluar = Index Of Array Value(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PembunuhBalasDendam), Global.PemainPembersihan);
						If(And(Global.IndeksDendamKeluar >= 0, Global.IndeksDendamKeluar < Count Of(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], JumlahBalasDendam))));
							Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PembunuhBalasDendam, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksDendamKeluar);
							Modify Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], JumlahBalasDendam, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksDendamKeluar);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamTerkunci) == Global.PemainPembersihan);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamTerkunci, Null);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamDipilih) == Global.PemainPembersihan);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], TargetBalasDendamDipilih, Null);
						End;
						If(Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PenagihBalasDendam) == Global.PemainPembersihan);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], PenagihBalasDendam, Null);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], KematianBalasDendam, False);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], WaktuPaksaBerikut, 0);
							Set Player Variable(Global.PemainManusia[Global.IndeksPemilih], WaktuPaksaBerakhir, 0);
						End;
					End;
				End;
				If(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.HudKananPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudKananPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				If(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
					Destroy In-World Text(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
				End;
				Global.SlotHUDTersedia = Sorted Array(Append To Array(Global.SlotHUDTersedia, Global.IndeksUtangKeluar), Current Array Element);
				Modify Global Variable(HudKiriPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(HudKananPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(HudMenuPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(TeksDuniaPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(SlotHUDPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Modify Global Variable(PemainManusia, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Global.IndeksPemilih = Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain);
				Global.SlotHUDTerakhir = Global.IndeksPemilih == 0 ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.SlotHUDPemain, Current Array Element));
				Call Subroutine(HitungPilihan);
			End;
			If(Global.IndeksKeluar == -2);
				If(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
					Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib);
				End;
				If(Event Player.IkonKebal != Null);
					Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKebal);
				End;
				If(Event Player.HudEfekNasib != Null);
					Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.HudEfekNasib);
				End;
				If(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
					Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
				End;
				If(Event Player.TeksTeleportasi != Null);
					Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksTeleportasi);
				End;
				Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
				Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
				Event Player.HudEfekNasib = Null;
				Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
				Event Player.TeksTeleportasi = Null;
				Event Player.HudKiri = Null;
				Event Player.HudKanan = Null;
				Event Player.HudMenu = Null;
				Event Player.TeksDunia = Null;
				Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = False;
				Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.HudKiriPemain));
					If(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudKiriPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(HudKiriPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.HudKananPemain));
					If(Global.HudKananPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudKananPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(HudKananPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.HudMenuPemain));
					If(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy HUD Text(Global.HudMenuPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(HudMenuPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.TeksDuniaPemain));
					If(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan] != 0);
						Destroy In-World Text(Global.TeksDuniaPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan]);
					End;
					Modify Global Variable(TeksDuniaPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				End;
				If(Global.IndeksPembersihan < Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain));
					Global.IndeksUtangKeluar = Global.SlotHUDPemain[Global.IndeksPembersihan];
					Modify Global Variable(SlotHUDPemain, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
					Global.SlotHUDTersedia = Append To Array(Global.SlotHUDTersedia, Global.IndeksUtangKeluar);
					Global.SlotHUDTersedia = Sorted Array(Global.SlotHUDTersedia, Current Array Element);
				End;
				Modify Global Variable(PemainManusia, Remove From Array By Index, Global.IndeksPembersihan);
				Global.IndeksPemilih = Count Of(Global.SlotHUDPemain);
				Global.SlotHUDTerakhir = Global.IndeksPemilih == 0 ? -1 : Last Of(Sorted Array(Global.SlotHUDPemain, Current Array Element));
				Call Subroutine(HitungPilihan);
			End;
		End;
		Global.IndeksKeluar = -1;
		Global.IndeksPembersihan = -1;
		Global.IndeksUtangKeluar = -1;
		Global.IndeksDendamKeluar = -1;
		Global.IndeksPemilih = 0;
		Global.PemainPembersihan = Null;
	}
}

rule("94 - Subrutin: Siapkan pemain dari ujung rambut sampai variabel")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SiapkanPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Is Dummy Bot(Event Player));
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
		Stop Transforming Throttle(Event Player);
		Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Gravity(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Environment(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuMasuk = Total Time Elapsed;
		Event Player.SudahDiperiksa = False;
		Event Player.BotOtomatis = False;
		Event Player.Manusia = False;
		Event Player.MenitLobi = 0;
		Event Player.IndeksGenre = -1;
		Event Player.MusikKhusus = Null;
		Event Player.SegarkanRosterTertunda = False;
		If(Or(Event Player.NamaTampilan == Null, Event Player.NamaTampilan == Custom String("")));
			Event Player.NamaTampilan = Null;
		End;
		Event Player.UrutanHUD = -1;
		Event Player.HudKiri = Null;
		Event Player.HudKanan = Null;
		Event Player.HudPemainDibuat = False;
		Event Player.MenuTerbuka = False;
		Event Player.KursorGenre = 0;
		Event Player.HudMenu = Null;
		Event Player.InspeksiAktif = False;
		Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Null;
		Event Player.TeksDunia = Null;
		Event Player.ModeKamera = 0;
		Event Player.TargetKamera = Null;
		Event Player.SeranganDekatDipakai = False;
		Event Player.HalamanMenu = -1;
		Event Player.KursorUtama = 0;
		Event Player.KursorKamera = 0;
		Event Player.KursorWarna = 0;
		Event Player.IndeksWarna = 0;
		Event Player.WarnaNama = Color(White);
		Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Null;
		Event Player.IndeksBahasa = 0;
		Event Player.KursorBahasa = 0;
		Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera = Empty Array;
		Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = 0;
		Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam = Empty Array;
		Event Player.PembunuhBalasDendam = Empty Array;
		Event Player.JumlahBalasDendam = Empty Array;
		Event Player.IndeksBalasDendam = -1;
		Event Player.KematianBalasDendam = False;
		Event Player.PenagihBalasDendam = Null;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.KursorTeleportasi = 0;
		Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi = Empty Array;
		Event Player.CalonTargetTeleportasi = Null;
		Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTeks = Null;
		Event Player.TeksTeleportasi = Null;
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.TargetBalasDendamTerkunci = Null;
		Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih = Null;
		Event Player.PelatNamaDinonaktifkan = False;
		Event Player.KunciBotAktif = False;
		Event Player.PahlawanTerakhir = Null;
		Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi = Empty Array;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Event Player.JenisTeleportasiTerkunci = -1;
		Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci = Null;
		Event Player.KebalAktif = False;
		Event Player.KursorKebal = 0;
		Event Player.IndeksSuara = 0;
		Event Player.KursorSuara = 0;
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokAktif = False;
		Event Player.PerintahTeleportasi = 0;
		Event Player.InteraksiKameraDipakai = False;
		Event Player.PosisiMati = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.BangkitLompatDipakai = False;
		Event Player.IndeksIkon = 0;
		Event Player.KursorIkon = 0;
		Event Player.WarnaMenu = Vector(255, 255, 255);
		Event Player.TeleportasiJongkokDiaktifkan = False;
		Event Player.KursorTeleportasiJongkok = 0;
		Event Player.PrivasiInspeksiAktif = False;
		Event Player.KursorPrivasiInspeksi = 0;
		Event Player.ModeKebal = 0;
		Event Player.IkonKebal = Null;
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif = False;
		Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
		Event Player.KursorPilihan = 0;
		Event Player.PemainDipilih = Null;
		Event Player.JumlahPilihan = 0;
		Event Player.PutaranKartuNasib = 0;
		Event Player.JedaKartuNasib = 0;
		Event Player.EfekNasib = 0;
		Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
		Event Player.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Event Player.HudEfekNasib = Null;
		Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
		Event Player.TimTerakhir = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.TimSiklusTarget = Team Of(Event Player);
		Event Player.WaktuTeleportasiDummy = 0;
		Event Player.IzinkanDummyMengikuti = False;
		Event Player.KursorIkutiDummy = 0;
		Event Player.TargetDummyIkuti = Null;
		Event Player.ModeHantuAktif = False;
		Event Player.ModeTerbangAktif = False;
		Event Player.KursorHantuTerbang = 0;
		Event Player.FisikaHantuTerbangDiterapkan = False;
		Event Player.WaktuBunuhDiriBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuMulaiTerbangMaju = -1;
		Event Player.PersenTerbang = 100;
		Event Player.ArahTerbang = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.DeltaTerbang = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi = Null;
		Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Event Player.TargetLampiranTeleportasi = Null;
		Event Player.LampiranTeleportasiAktif = False;
		Event Player.PahlawanLampiranSendiri = Null;
		Event Player.PahlawanLampiranTarget = Null;
		Event Player.WaktuSiklusTim = 0;
		Event Player.PernahDisiapkan = True;
		Event Player.PindahTimDiproses = True;
		Event Player.SiklusPemainAktif = False;
		Event Player.SudahSiap = True;
	}
}

rule("95 - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar tontonan, termasuk para bot")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetKamera;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(And(Event Player.KursorKamera >= 2, Event Player.KursorKamera - 2 < Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera)));
			Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera[Event Player.KursorKamera - 2];
		Else;
			Event Player.CalonTargetKamera = Null;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetPublikPemain);
		Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera = Filtered Array(Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi, Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True);
		If(And(Event Player.CalonTargetKamera != Null, Array Contains(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera, Event Player.CalonTargetKamera)));
			Event Player.KursorKamera = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera, Event Player.CalonTargetKamera) + 2;
		Else If(Event Player.KursorKamera >= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetKamera) + 2);
			Event Player.KursorKamera = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("96 - Subrutin: Cari target publik terdekat dari bidikan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetInspeksi;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi == Null, Or(Entity Exists(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi) == False, Is Alive(Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi) == False)));
			Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Null;
		Else;
			Event Player.TargetInspeksi = Event Player.CalonTargetInspeksi;
		End;
	}
}

rule("97 - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar target balas dendam")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetBalasDendam;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.KursorBalasDendam < Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam));
			Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih = Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam[Event Player.KursorBalasDendam];
		Else;
			Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih = Null;
		End;
		Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam = Filtered Array(Global.PemainManusia, Current Array Element != Event Player);
		If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam) == 0);
			Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = 0;
		Else If(And(Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih != Null, Array Contains(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam, Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih)));
			Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = Index Of Array Value(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam, Event Player.TargetBalasDendamDipilih);
		Else If(Event Player.KursorBalasDendam >= Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetBalasDendam));
			Event Player.KursorBalasDendam = 0;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98 - Subrutin: Cari target teleport publik terdekat dari bidikan")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetTeleportasi;
	}

	actions
	{
		Call Subroutine(SegarkanTargetPublikPemain);
		Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi = Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi;
		If(Count Of(Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi) == 0);
			Event Player.CalonTargetTeleportasi = Null;
		Else;
			Event Player.CalonTargetTeleportasi = First Of(Sorted Array(Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi, Angle Between Vectors(Facing Direction Of(Event Player), Direction Towards(Eye Position(Event Player), Eye Position(Current Array Element)))));
		End;
	}
}

rule("98a - Subrutin: Pulihkan status Nasib untuk Event Player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PulihkanNasibPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Event Player.IkonKartuNasib);
		End;
		If(Event Player.HudEfekNasib != Null);
			Destroy HUD Text(Event Player.HudEfekNasib);
		End;
		If(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Event Player.TeksVisiNasib);
		End;
		Event Player.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
		Event Player.HudEfekNasib = Null;
		Event Player.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
		Clear Status(Event Player, Burning);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Hacked);
		Clear Status(Event Player, Unkillable);
		If(Event Player.EfekNasib == 2);
			Stop Accelerating(Event Player);
			Set Move Speed(Event Player, 100);
		End;
		Set Damage Received(Event Player, 100);
		Set Knockback Received(Event Player, 100);
		Enable Movement Collision With Players(Event Player);
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Event Player, 100);
		Event Player.KartuNasibAktif = False;
		Event Player.PutaranKartuNasib = 0;
		Event Player.JedaKartuNasib = 0;
		Event Player.EfekNasib = 0;
		Event Player.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
		Event Player.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Event Player.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Event Player.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Event Player.KebalAktif = Event Player.ModeKebal != 0;
		Event Player.InputMenuDikunci = False;
		Event Player.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Event Player, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("98b - Subrutin: Pulihkan status Nasib untuk pemain aktif global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		PulihkanNasibAktif;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.PemainAktif == Null, Entity Exists(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
		If(Global.PemainAktif.IkonKartuNasib != Null);
			Destroy Icon(Global.PemainAktif.IkonKartuNasib);
		End;
		If(Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib != Null);
			Destroy HUD Text(Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib);
		End;
		If(Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib);
		End;
		Global.PemainAktif.IkonKartuNasib = Null;
		Global.PemainAktif.HudEfekNasib = Null;
		Global.PemainAktif.TeksVisiNasib = Null;
		Clear Status(Global.PemainAktif, Burning);
		Clear Status(Global.PemainAktif, Hacked);
		If(Or(Global.PemainAktif.ModeKebal == 0, Is Alive(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
			Clear Status(Global.PemainAktif, Unkillable);
			Set Damage Received(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
			Set Knockback Received(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
			Enable Movement Collision With Players(Global.PemainAktif);
		End;
		If(Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasib == 2);
			Stop Accelerating(Global.PemainAktif);
			Set Move Speed(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
		End;
		Set Jump Vertical Speed(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
		Set Projectile Speed(Global.PemainAktif, 100);
		Global.PemainAktif.KartuNasibAktif = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.PutaranKartuNasib = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.JedaKartuNasib = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasib = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.EfekNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.PrivasiNasibAktif = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuBakarNasibBerikut = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPutaranNasibBerikut = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuIkonNasibBerakhir = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPaksaBerikut = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.WaktuPaksaBerakhir = 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.MenuNasibHarusDibuka = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.KebalAktif = Global.PemainAktif.ModeKebal != 0;
		Global.PemainAktif.InputMenuDikunci = False;
		Global.PemainAktif.PerintahMenu = 0;
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Primary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Secondary Fire));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Interact));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Reload));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Ability 1));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Ability 2));
		Allow Button(Global.PemainAktif, Button(Ultimate));
	}
}

rule("98c - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar target publik untuk Event Player")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetPublikPemain;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.DaftarTargetInspeksi = Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Event Player, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True, Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, BotOtomatis) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, Manusia) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PrivasiInspeksiAktif) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, SegarkanRosterTertunda) == False))))))));
	}
}

rule("98d - Subrutin: Segarkan daftar target publik untuk pemain aktif global")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		SegarkanTargetPublikAktif;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Or(Global.PemainAktif == Null, Entity Exists(Global.PemainAktif) == False));
		Set Player Variable(Global.PemainAktif, DaftarTargetInspeksi, Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Current Array Element != Global.PemainAktif, And(Entity Exists(Current Array Element), And(Is Alive(Current Array Element), Or(Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True, Or(Player Variable(Current Array Element, BotOtomatis) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, Manusia) == True, And(Player Variable(Current Array Element, PrivasiInspeksiAktif) == False, Player Variable(Current Array Element, SegarkanRosterTertunda) == False)))))))));
	}
}

rule("98e - Subrutin: Buat dummy sesuai tim aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		BuatDummyTim;
	}

	actions
	{
		Create Dummy Bot(All Heroes, Global.TimDummyAktif, -1, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Global.TimDummyAktif))), Vector(0, 0, 1));
	}
}

rule("98f - Subrutin: Lepas dummy sesuai tim aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		LepasDummyTim;
	}

	actions
	{
		Abort If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimDummyAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)) == 0);
		If(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimDummyAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), TeksVisiNasib) != Null);
			Destroy In-World Text(Player Variable(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimDummyAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)), TeksVisiNasib));
		End;
		Stop Facing(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimDummyAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)));
		Stop Throttle In Direction(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimDummyAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True)));
		Destroy Dummy Bot(Global.TimDummyAktif, Slot Of(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(Global.TimDummyAktif), Is Dummy Bot(Current Array Element) == True))));
	}
}

rule("98g - Subrutin: Teleportasi ke Spawn Room")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TeleportKeSpawn;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Is In Spawn Room(Event Player) == True);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Already in Spawn Room.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Kamu sudah di ruang muncul. Misi selesai.") : Custom String("คุณอยู่ในห้องเกิดแล้ว ภารกิจสำเร็จ"));
		Else If(Count Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player))) == 0);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Spawn Room unavailable.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Ruang muncul tidak tersedia di map ini saat ini.") : Custom String("ห้องเกิดยังไม่พร้อมใช้งานบนแผนที่นี้"));
		Else;
			Teleport(Event Player, Position Of(First Of(Spawn Points(Team Of(Event Player)))));
		End;
	}
}

rule("98h - Subrutin: Teleportasi ke objektif mode aktif")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TeleportKeObjektif;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		If(Or(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Escort), Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Hybrid)));
			If(Distance Between(Payload Position, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Payload Position + Vector(2, 0, 0);
			End;
		Else If(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Capture The Flag));
			If(Distance Between(Flag Position(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player))), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Flag Position(Opposite Team Of(Team Of(Event Player))) + Vector(2, 0, 0);
			End;
		Else If(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Push));
			If(Count Of(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True, And(Is Alive(Current Array Element) == True, Is On Objective(Current Array Element) == True)))) > 0);
				Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(First Of(Filtered Array(All Players(All Teams), And(Has Spawned(Current Array Element) == True, And(Is Alive(Current Array Element) == True, Is On Objective(Current Array Element) == True))))) + Vector(2, 0, 0);
			Else If(Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Objective Position(Objective Index);
			End;
		Else If(Or(Or(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Flashpoint), Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Control)), Or(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Clash), Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Assault))));
			If(Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
				Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Objective Position(Objective Index);
			End;
		Else If(Distance Between(Objective Position(Objective Index), Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Objective Position(Objective Index);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Objective unavailable.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Posisi objektif belum tersedia saat ini.") : Custom String("ตำแหน่งเป้าหมายยังไม่พร้อมใช้งานตอนนี้"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No safe walkable position was found near the objective.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tidak ada posisi aman yang bisa dilalui dekat objektif.") : Custom String("ไม่พบตำแหน่งที่ปลอดภัยและเดินได้ใกล้เป้าหมาย"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman);
		If(Or(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Escort), Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Hybrid)));
		Else If(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Capture The Flag));
		Else If(Current Game Mode == Game Mode(Push));
		Else;
		End;
	}
}

rule("98i - Subrutin: Teleportasi ke target pemain")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		TeleportKeTarget;
	}

	actions
	{
		If(Or(Or(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci == Null, Entity Exists(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) == False), Or(Is Alive(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) == False, Array Contains(Event Player.DaftarTargetTeleportasi, Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) == False)));
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("Target unavailable. Even teleportation has standards.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Target sedang tidak tersedia. Teleportasi juga punya standar.") : Custom String("เป้าหมายไม่พร้อมใช้งาน แม้แต่เทเลพอร์ตก็มีมาตรฐาน"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) - Facing Direction Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) * 2.250;
		Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Facing Direction Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) * 2.250;
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(2.250, 0, 0);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(-2.250, 0, 0);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(0, 0, 2.250);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan = Position Of(Event Player.TargetTeleportasiTerkunci) + Vector(0, 0, -2.250);
			Call Subroutine(CariPosisiTeleportAman);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Small Message(Event Player, Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 0 ? Custom String("No safe walkable position was found near that target.") : Event Player.IndeksBahasa == 1 ? Custom String("Tidak ada posisi aman yang bisa dilalui dekat target itu.") : Custom String("ไม่พบตำแหน่งที่ปลอดภัยและเดินได้ใกล้เป้าหมายนั้น"));
			Abort;
		End;
		Teleport(Event Player, Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman);
	}
}

rule("98j - Subrutin: Cari posisi teleport aman")
{
	event
	{
		Subroutine;
		CariPosisiTeleportAman;
	}

	actions
	{
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		Abort If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
		Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan);
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		"Jauhkan titik teleport dari dinding sebelum memeriksa tanah dan jalur akhir."
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.500, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.500, 0, 0));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.500, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.500, 0, 0));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0, -1.500));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, -1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 1.250);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Nearest Walkable Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0, 1.500));
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) <= 0.100);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.000, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.000, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 1.000), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, -1.000), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) < 0.850);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.250, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 2.500, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.250, 0)) < 2.000);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan) > 8);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 5, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman - Vector(0, 20, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman) > 6);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
			Abort;
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiTeleportTujuan + Vector(0, 1, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1, 0)) > 0.750);
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
		End;
		If(Distance Between(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman, Vector(0, 0, 0)) > 0.100);
			"Periksa lagi ruang badan dan kepala setelah semua koreksi dinding; titik sempit dibatalkan agar pemanggil mencoba posisi lain."
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(1.500, 1.000, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(-1.500, 1.000, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, -1.500), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 1.000, 0)) < 1.250);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			If(Distance Between(Ray Cast Hit Position(Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.500, 0), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 2.750, 0), Empty Array, Empty Array, False), Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman + Vector(0, 0.500, 0)) < 2.000);
				Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman = Vector(0, 0, 0);
				Abort;
			End;
			Event Player.PosisiBangkitAman += Vector(0, 0.500, 0);
		End;
	}
}
